headline: Man United audit squad as new boss Pochettino inherits Rashford, Fernandes and Shaw contract questions
facts: Pochettino has just taken over United, who sit in the relegation zone and are chasing a first league win since August.
Rashford reportedly earns the club's top wage of about 325,000 pounds a week and United failed to sell him in each of the last two summers.
Shaw's contract ends this season; Fernandes can be kept to 2028 via a one-year option; Martinez is out of contract next summer.
background: Pochettino was previously in charge of Southampton, Tottenham, Chelsea and PSG, and left the US men's national team job after the World Cup round of 16. United hired him on a two-year deal after sacking Michael Carrick.

headline: Arsenal revive interest in Athletic's Nico Williams with a EUR 100m clause in play
facts: TEAMtalk reports Arsenal have renewed interest in the Spain winger, a World Cup winner.
Williams signed a 10-year extension last summer carrying a EUR 100m release clause and is reportedly open to leaving.
Arsenal are also weighing Endrick, Antonio Nusa, Kevin Schade and Alex Baena.
background: Williams is a Spain international who came through at Athletic Club and was a Euro 2024 winner. A reported move to Barcelona was a long-running saga in previous windows.
footage_terms: Nico Williams Spain World Cup goals

headline: Real Madrid expected to trigger EUR 80m clause to bring Nico Paz back from Como
facts: Mundo Deportivo reports Madrid are expected to use Paz's EUR 80m buy-back and have until next summer.
The 22-year-old joined Como for about EUR 6m in 2024 and a restructured EUR 60m deal last summer raised the clause.
Chelsea, Manchester United and Arsenal are reportedly monitoring him; Como say he remains fully their player.
background: Paz is an Argentine midfielder who came through Real Madrid's academy and moved to Como, where Cesc Fabregas is coach, in 2024.

headline: Barcelona's Deco open to Liverpool making Ronald Araujo loan permanent for EUR 55m
facts: Araujo, 27, joined Liverpool on loan in the summer and has two goals in 15 appearances.
Liverpool hold an option to buy for EUR 55m, with a deadline, and Deco hinted Barcelona could be flexible on timing and fee.
Liverpool would still need to agree personal terms with the player.
background: Araujo is a Uruguayan centre-back who has been at Barcelona since 2018. Barcelona's financial limits make selling players a recurring theme.

headline: Vinicius Junior back from ban as Mourinho says he is not at 100 percent after summer transfer saga
facts: Arsenal were among clubs chasing Vinicius in the summer while Madrid debated a renewal.
Mourinho says he is not at 100 percent and the player admitted he prepared badly and trained less than usual in the break.
He served a four-game ban for pulling Villarreal's Nathan Saliba by the hair, has one Madrid goal this season, but scored five in two Brazil friendlies including a hat-trick against Singapore.
background: Vinicius has been at Real Madrid since 2018 and won the Champions League with the club. Ancelotti, who coached him at Madrid, now coaches Brazil.

headline: Besiktas eye Manchester United's Matthijs de Ligt on January loan with obligation to buy
facts: TEAMtalk reports Besiktas are exploring a January move for the 27-year-old.
Any loan would have to include an obligation to buy; no fee was reported.
Fulham's Calvin Bassey is linked as a possible United replacement.
background: De Ligt joined United from Bayern Munich for about EUR 45m, as listed in the Pochettino squad audit. He previously played for Ajax and Juventus.
footage_terms: Matthijs de Ligt Manchester United highlights

headline: Napoli ask about EUR 7m for Kevin De Bruyne as PSV prepare new bid
facts: PSV's opening bid is reported around EUR 2m, while Napoli want about EUR 7m, per La Gazzetta dello Sport.
De Bruyne, 35, has under a year left plus a 12-month option Napoli are not expected to trigger.
Allegri reportedly opposes a midseason sale; De Bruyne reportedly wants to live closer to Belgium. PSV coach Bosz would not discuss him while he is a Napoli player.
background: De Bruyne spent a decade at Manchester City before joining Napoli. He is widely seen as one of the Premier League's great playmakers.

headline: Van Dijk and Liverpool split on contract length as AC Milan circle
facts: His Liverpool contract expires on 30 June 2027.
Liverpool reportedly offered one year to 2028 with an option for another at much lower pay; he reportedly wants to 2029.
Sportitalia reports Milan see him as a summer 2027 target and would make a written offer if no Liverpool deal is reached.
background: Van Dijk joined Liverpool from Southampton in January 2018 for 75 million pounds and has won the Premier League and the Champions League with the club.

headline: Guardiola's agent denies formal Saudi national team offer
facts: Reports said the Saudi federation opened talks about Guardiola succeeding Giorgos Donis as national coach.
Agent Josep Maria Orobitg denied any official offer, saying contact was only through intermediaries.
Guardiola is not considering offers for now and will review options, including Saudi Pro League clubs, before next season.
background: Guardiola's spell at Manchester City ran from 2016 to 2026, according to the article. He won the treble with City in 2023.

headline: Brahim Diaz reportedly set for new Real Madrid deal with EUR 1bn clause while Besiktas circle
facts: El Chiringuito says Madrid agreed to extend him to 2031 with a EUR 1bn release clause, with an announcement expected the next week.
He has played only 149 La Liga minutes this season, behind Bellingham and Guler.
Besiktas want him in January; his father visited Istanbul and met president Serdar Adali and coach Vincenzo Italiano.
background: Diaz is a Morocco international who has been in and out of Real Madrid's plans since returning from AC Milan.

headline: McTominay wants about EUR 7m a year as Napoli talks stall and Milan watch
facts: His Napoli contract runs to June 2028 but no new deal is agreed because he reportedly wants about EUR 7m a season.
Real Madrid and Manchester United are monitoring; Milan hope the impasse helps them.
Adidas is reported to return as Milan kit supplier from 2028-29 in a deal near EUR 500m over 10 years, and McTominay is an Adidas ambassador.
background: McTominay left Manchester United for Napoli, after growing up in United's academy and playing for Scotland.

headline: Valencia sound out Barcelona about Ter Stegen as struggling club eye a goalkeeper swap
facts: Onda Deportiva Valencia reports sporting director Braulio Vazquez has started inquiries about the 34-year-old, now on loan at Ajax.
Barcelona pay 90 percent of his wages on loan and his contract runs to 2028; no formal offer has arrived.
Valencia are second-from-bottom in La Liga, have conceded 20 goals in 12 games, and a US group is reportedly buying 42 percent from Peter Lim's Meriton.
background: Ter Stegen spent over a decade as Barcelona's first-choice goalkeeper before going out on loan.

headline: AC Milan and Galatasaray reportedly eye Bruno Fernandes on a free next July
facts: Journalist Nicolo Schira reports both clubs are interested in a free transfer in July.
United have reportedly offered an extension to 2029 but nothing is agreed.
Fernandes is 32.
background: Fernandes joined United from Sporting in January 2020 and has been captain.

headline: Arsenal join race for Bournemouth's Alex Scott as sales would be needed
facts: Arsenal reportedly entered the race after Bournemouth softened on a sale; Liverpool are said to lead, partly due to manager Andoni Iraola.
Scott's contract runs to 2028 and Transfermarkt values him at EUR 70m; other reports cite about 100m pounds.
Arsenal would need to sell a midfielder such as Merino or Zubimendi to make room.
background: Scott moved from Bristol City to Bournemouth and won his first England cap this season.

headline: Bayern reportedly make contact with Liverpool teenager Rio Ngumoha's representatives
facts: TEAMtalk reports Bayern contacted the 18-year-old's representatives.
Liverpool reportedly will not entertain offers.
He enters the final 18 months of his contract in January.
background: Ngumoha is a teenage Liverpool winger who joined the club from Chelsea's academy.

headline: Tchouameni signs new Real Madrid contract to 2032
facts: ESPN lists the French midfielder's new Real Madrid deal to 2032 as a done deal.
background: Tchouameni joined Real Madrid from Monaco in 2022 and plays for France.

headline: Valencia ask about Aston Villa striker Tammy Abraham on January loan
facts: Valencia are pursuing the 29-year-old, who has started once under Emery this season.
They asked about a January loan with Villa covering part of his wages.
background: Abraham is an English striker who has played for Chelsea, Roma and Milan before Villa.

headline: Bayern open to offers for Kim Min-jae with Premier League clubs linked
facts: Bayern are reportedly open to offers for the centre-back.
Tottenham, Arsenal, Aston Villa, AC Milan and Fenerbahce are all linked.
background: Kim is a South Korea defender who joined Bayern from Napoli in 2023.

headline: Wilfried Zaha could return to Crystal Palace after training with club
facts: TalkSPORT reports the free agent could rejoin Palace.
He has been training with the club since the summer.
background: Zaha is a former Palace winger and Ivory Coast international who became a club icon.

headline: Lukaku could be offered Anderlecht return in January
facts: ESPN's roundup says Anderlecht could try to re-sign the Fenerbahce striker in January.
background: Lukaku began his career at Anderlecht and is Belgium's record scorer.

headline: Julian Alvarez at centre of Arsenal, Man United and Barcelona chase
facts: Goal says Arsenal staff reportedly met Alvarez and his agents in Madrid and a formal offer could come in January.
Atletico's president Cerezo reportedly blocked a Barcelona move and Atletico reportedly want a huge fee.
FourFourTwo reports Pochettino asked United about Alvarez, but finances may not allow a January deal.
background: Alvarez left Manchester City for Atletico Madrid and scored 29 goals in his first season under Simeone.

headline: Balde in limbo at Barcelona as Man United and Juventus linked
facts: The 23-year-old has made five appearances, all as a substitute, behind Cancelo and Espart.
Deco says he will not be sold unless he asks to leave; ESPN lists a possible EUR 40m permanent deal and Juventus loan interest.
He has 173 Barcelona appearances and seven trophies.
background: Balde joined Barcelona aged eight and debuted in 2021.

headline: Flick asks Barcelona for two January signings amid defensive crisis
facts: Sport reports Flick wants an experienced centre-back and a reliable left-back in January.
The left-back move depends on Balde leaving; Financial Fair Play is the main barrier.
A Balde sale or Liverpool taking up the Araujo option could raise funds.
background: Flick took over Barcelona in 2024. He previously won a treble with Bayern Munich.

headline: Newcastle face six-club battle for Feyenoord winger Anis Hadj Moussa
facts: The 24-year-old Algeria winger is wanted by Newcastle, Sunderland, Brighton, Dortmund, Porto and Sporting.
Feyenoord reportedly rejected bids around 35m pounds.
He has 8 goals in 15 games this season; Newcastle signed Bazoumana Toure for 43m pounds after Anthony Gordon left for Barcelona.
background: Hadj Moussa is an Algeria international at Feyenoord.

headline: Juventus CEO admits settlement limits spending ahead of January
facts: Carnevali says a settlement agreement stops big investments in top players.
The priority needs are a striker and a left-back, with a midfielder possible.
The club may sell surplus wide attackers to raise money.
background: Juventus reached a financial settlement after recapitalisation-era problems.

headline: Barcelona reportedly reject free transfer of Lisandro Martinez
facts: Agent Pedro Bravo says he offered the defender to Deco, who declined.
Deco reportedly said he does not fit Barcelona's needs; his contract runs to summer 2027.
Barcelona want a left-footed centre-back who can also cover at full-back.
background: Martinez won the World Cup with Argentina and joined United from Ajax in 2022.

headline: Kovacic set to leave Manchester City, with Atletico interested
facts: The 32-year-old is in the final months of his contract.
He has 8 appearances and 373 minutes this season.
Atletico reportedly rate him and estimates put his value near EUR 10m.
background: Kovacic has played for Inter, Real Madrid, Chelsea and Manchester City.

headline: Leno says no Bayern contact yet as club eye Neuer successor
facts: The 34-year-old has a Fulham deal to 2027 with a club option.
Bayern expect Neuer to retire at season's end and Leno is a reported candidate.
Leno told Sky Germany nobody from Bayern has contacted him.
background: Leno is a German goalkeeper who previously played for Arsenal.

headline: Man United reportedly plan January move for Leipzig's Antonio Nusa
facts: Di Marzio puts the price at about EUR 70-80m while Transfermarkt values him at EUR 45m.
United are said to want the Sesko-style exceptional offer, with Sesko out until the New Year.
He has 11 goals and assists in nine Bundesliga games; a 2024 Brentford move collapsed.
background: Nusa is a 21-year-old Norway winger who had a strong World Cup.

headline: Gvardiol exit talks reportedly begun, Barcelona interested
facts: Reports say exit talks may begin as early as the summer.
Barcelona's Flick wants him, but a winter deal is described as almost impossible for funding reasons.
Transfermarkt values the 24-year-old at EUR 75m.
background: Gvardiol joined Manchester City from RB Leipzig in 2023.

headline: Arsenal face unpopular contract decisions as seven players near expiry
facts: The Telegraph says Raya, Havertz, Odegaard, White, Rice, Merino and Timber are within 18 months of expiry.
Only Rice, Raya and Timber are reportedly close to new deals.
Odegaard says he wants to stay but talks have not started.
background: Arsenal won their first Premier League title in 22 years under Mikel Arteta, according to the article.

headline: Raya reportedly close to Arsenal extension after saying he would like La Liga one day
facts: The 31-year-old is reportedly very close to a new deal; his current contract runs to 2028.
He told Marca he would love to play in La Liga someday.
Real Madrid reportedly see him as a possible Courtois successor.
background: Raya joined Arsenal from Brentford in 2023 and has won the Golden Glove each season.

headline: Arsenal reportedly chase Paraguayan teenager Eduardo Delmas
facts: Deporte Total says Arsenal are seriously pursuing the 19-year-old.
Olimpia president Rodrigo Nogues wants more than 10m pounds.
Real Madrid and PSG are also scouting.
background: Delmas plays for Olimpia in Paraguay; Arsenal scouts reportedly watched him score in the Superclasico.
